verdict.rationale: LlamaExtract documents extraction "with citations" so values can be verified against the source document. Parse adds source-page provenance for extracted tables and bounding boxes for enriched form fields. These provenance pieces are spread across separate features, and no doc shows every extracted field carrying page number, bounding box and source snippet together. Missing for 10: explicit per-field page number plus bounding box plus source snippet in Extract output, schema/API documentation of the citation format, independent or hands-on corroboration.
